name: EmoAssist Benchmark
description: The rapid advancement of large multi-modality models (LMMs) has significantly propelled the integration of artificial intelligence into practical applications. Visual Question Answering (VQA) systems, which can process multi-modal data including vision, text, and audio, hold great potential for assisting the Visual Impairment (VI) community in navigating complex and dynamic real-world environments. However, existing VI assistive LMMs overlook the emotional needs of VI individuals, and current benchmarks lack emotional evaluation of these LMMs.
